# Tanmay Sahare

> Founder of VarshaKrishi Udhyog Pvt. Ltd.: satellite crop advice for Indian smallholder farmers, delivered weekly in the farmer's language on WhatsApp. B.Tech Aerospace Engineering student at IIT Kanpur; EiR Fellow, 5G/6G Centre of Excellence, FIRST, IIT Kanpur.

## Who
Tanmay Sahare is an Indian engineer and founder. VarshaKrishi builds one product: satellite crop advice for Indian farmers, delivered weekly in the farmer's language on WhatsApp. Watch is free and national; Decide is crop-specific, reviewed by agronomists, and proven one crop and one belt at a time, starting with citrus in Vidarbha. The product reads free satellite imagery (Sentinel-2, NASA HLS, Sentinel-1) and weather, and every message carries its source, its observation date and its limits. Advice is reviewed in Marathi and Hindi; other languages are machine-translated and labelled. Agronomy engines are built from cited literature (FAO-56 evapotranspiration, TOMCAST disease severity values).

## Company facts
- VarshaKrishi Udhyog Private Limited, incorporated 5 March 2026, CIN U01113UW2026PTC250001, DPIIT-recognised (DIPP255998).
- EiR Fellow, 5G/6G Centre of Excellence, FIRST, IIT Kanpur.
- Patent application published August 2026 (priority June 2026).
- First competitive tender awarded April 2026; the project did not proceed. No farmer cohort or site is claimed yet.
- Hardware: the company does not build sensors; it procures reference kits only where a contract names them.
